name: Perp-spot basis discount contrarian — long the over-cheap spot (SPOT-executable)
rationale: SPOT / LONG LEG (direction=1) — the absent mirror of perp-basis-premium-contrarian-short, and unlike that short leg it IS executable on Binance SPOT (buy spot outright; no perp-short capability needed), so it fits the spot-only live constraint. Mechanism, stated before the data: the perp-spot basis (perp minus spot, as a fraction) is the market's revealed price of leverage. A large NEGATIVE basis means perpetual SHORTS are paying a premium to stay short while spot trades rich to the discounted perp — a crowded, over-leveraged-SHORT regime that historically reverts UP as the marginal short is exhausted and negative-carry/short-funding bleed forces shorts to cover (a short squeeze into spot). The basis is a spot-perp price SPREAD (a cleaner, higher-frequency crowding read than the realized funding print) so it can fire EARLIER than a funding-contrarian filter. Hypothesis: go LONG spot when perp_spot_basis crosses DOWN through a fitted discount floor (short-crowding extreme) AND price is not in a violent downtrend (ret_Nd above a fitted trend_floor — the knife guard, mirroring the short leg's melt-up guard) so we buy capitulation, not freefall. Exit when the basis normalizes back UP through an exit threshold (crowding relieved, thesis played out) or the stop/TP/time barrier fires. Disconfirmer 1: the edge must be the basis EXTREME mean-reverting, not a generic long bias — if a plain unconditional spot long over the same sample and costs matches the deflated Sharpe, the basis floor adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: basis and funding are tightly coupled; if dropping perp_spot_basis and entering on a funding_rate floor alone does as well, this is the existing funding-contrarian spec re-skinned and adds no orthogonal basis information. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): net of Binance spot fees the reversion must clear ~20bps round-trip; statistically-significant-but-fee-dead is dead. tier0 feature, unproven combination — low-confidence until validated OOS.
catalyst: perp_spot_basis crosses down into a discount regime (perp shorts over-paying / spot rich to perp) — a crowded short-squeeze setup, bought on spot.
